model.name: Migliore et al. 2005 CA1 pyramidal cell, soma only (SomaOnly_allCml)
model.citation: Migliore M, Ferrante M, Ascoli GA (2005). Signal Propagation in Oblique Dendrites of CA1 Pyramidal Cells. Journal of Neurophysiology 94(6):4145-4155. doi:10.1152/jn.00521.2005
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment (7.49 x 7.49 um) taken from the multicompartment CA1 cell ("Only soma of more detailed cell"). hd (Ih, erev -30 mV) 0.05, kad 30, kap 30, kdr 10, na3 25, nax 125, pasCA1 0.0357 mS/cm2; no Ca. Harness: +0.038 nA 20-80 ms. Shipped reference for the jNeuroML OMV test (.test.mep): 4 spikes 25.4-80.2 ms, ISI about 18.3 ms throughout (tonic, non-adapting). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: MIT; jNeuroML OMV test (check-runs: jNeuroML success). Independent family with strong A-type K (kap/kad) and a small Ih. Short harness (100 ms, 4 spikes) is a weak canonical test; very small soma, so the rheobase search needs a small-cell bracket. The nax channel lineage overlaps Migliore et al. 2014 (same lab): consider grouping with migliore2014 when splitting.
